description: List every file in a course's Files area, returning metadata only — name, size, content type, folder_id, and the Canvas-hosted download URL — not the file's content. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use download_file to fetch a file's actual content, get_file to refetch a single file's metadata by ID, list_folders for the folder tree these files sit in, and find_duplicate_files to spot same-name-and-size copies left over from course copies.
name: list_files
title: List Files
